Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
the piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
when the hall clock struck eleven, the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven
the temple struck eleven, after which Lina was still with Rosa

durations: a quarter of an hour (the kitchen clock's amount of being fast, stated as known exactly)
a quarter of an hour (stated again as how far the kitchen clock is fast)
about 13 minutes (piano playing, implied from 10:58 to 11:11 on the kitchen clock)
for years (Madame has teased Rosa about the clock)
for years (Rosa has lived by that clock)

whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen and sat at Rosa's table.
Fräulein Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven.
Rosa had the champagne glasses out tonight and washed them twice.
Rosa was in and out with the plates during dinner.
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa went upstairs when it was nearly time for the toast, to fetch the master.
The master was found upstairs on the floor by his bench, dead.
Rosa did not touch the master's body and then screamed.
